TARGET_URL: https://followtheinsider.com/

TITLE: Insider Alpha – Congressional Stock Trading Data & Signals

META_DESCRIPTION: Track every stock trade disclosed by U.S. Congress and executive officials under the STOCK Act. 54,000+ trades from 2012 to today, searchable by filer or ticker. Premium members get CSV exports and real-time alerts.

OG_TITLE: Insider Alpha – Congressional Stock Trading Data

OG_DESCRIPTION: Track 54,000+ congressional stock trades disclosed under the STOCK Act. Real-time signals, filer analysis, and exportable data for traders and researchers.

CANONICAL: https://followtheinsider.com/
